shots.prompt: The camera follows the man in the rust-red coat from behind as he walks down the road away from the camera, his coat swinging with each step.
The camera moves around to his side and holds. He keeps walking, hands in his pockets, his boots stepping on the white line of the road.
The camera tilts up away from him to the sky. The clouds drift slowly and their orange edges fade toward blue.
The camera holds on the man in the rust-red coat from the side. He stops walking, lifts his head, and looks ahead down the road.
The camera moves in behind the man in the rust-red coat. He starts walking again, slowly, his shoulders moving under the coat.
The camera looks past him down the road. Far away at the end of the road a stone gate stands with one lantern burning, and rain begins to fall.
The camera holds still. The man in the rust-red coat walks toward the distant gate, getting smaller in the frame, until he reaches the light.
